title: Pan-Seared Calamarata with Broccoli
description: A quick keto pasta dish featuring pan-seared calamarata and steamed broccoli.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook calamarata according to package instructions.
While the pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add broccoli to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the broccoli from the skillet and set aside.
Add the cooked calamarata to the skillet and toss with garlic and olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the calamarata hot with steamed broccoli on top.
